newsitem.title: USA: HP to unveil encryption breakthrough.
newsitem.headline: HP to unveil encryption breakthrough.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co. said on Friday that it will unveil on Monday a breakthrough agreement in computer software encryption, a development that could eliminate a key impediment to the growth of electronic commerce via the Internet.

A spokesman said H-P Chairman and Chief Executive Lewis Platt will provide details of a deal involving computer industry leaders, the Clinton administation and other governments at a press conference in Washington.

The company confirmed that the technology will enable export of strong encryption capabilities, such as those that companies want to use for tasks ranging from confidential communications to electronic commerce.
